# m.economy.inflation

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

US inflation: CPI, core CPI, and the PCE price indexes and spending, one row per month.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.economy.inflation(*, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Date`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first date; a calendar date only. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last date, inclusive; None also returns rows dated in the future. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Massive's field to sort by, such as `"date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`; it needs `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The total-row cap. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters. Keys: none. |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Cpi` | double | Consumer Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers — a standard measure of headline inflation based on a fixed basket of goods and services, not seasonally adjusted. |
| `CpiCore` | double | Core Consumer Price Index — the CPI excluding food and energy, used to understand underlying inflation trends without short-term volatility. |
| `CpiYearOverYear` | double | Year-over-year percentage change in the headline CPI — the most commonly cited inflation rate in public discourse and economic policy. |
| `Date` | String | Calendar date of the observation (YYYY‑MM‑DD). |
| `Pce` | double | Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index — a broader measure of inflation used by the Federal Reserve, reflecting actual consumer spending patterns and updated basket weights. |
| `PceCore` | double | Core PCE Price Index — excludes food and energy prices from the PCE index, and is the Fed's preferred measure of underlying inflation. |
| `PceSpending` | double | Nominal Personal Consumption Expenditures — total dollar value of consumer spending in the U.S. economy, reported in billions of dollars and not adjusted for inflation. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
